display.title: Miracles in 5751: Hashem Never Sleeps
display.summary_short: Hashem guards the Jewish people day and night, often with miracles we do not even notice, so we thank Him in Modim and serve Him with simcha.
display.summary_long: A short talk from the Tzivos Hashem radio show, given in the winter of 5751 while the Jewish people were seeing great miracles of protection. Uncle Yossi quotes Dovid HaMelech in Tehillim: the Guardian of Israel neither slumbers nor sleeps. Our Sages teach that sometimes even the person a miracle happens to does not recognize it, so many miracles happen before our eyes unnoticed. That is why, three times a day in the Modim blessing of Shemoneh Esrei, we bow and thank Hashem for His miracles and wonders every evening, morning and afternoon, and pray to Him alone for peace. That peace will come with Moshiach, who will gather the Jewish people to Eretz Yisroel, the land Hashem watches constantly. Knowing how close Hashem is fills us with simcha, and in the merit of simcha we will leave golus.
display.lesson: Notice and thank Hashem for the everyday miracles, and let that knowledge fill you with joy.
